hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester one builds marketing foundations and data-driven decision-making skills while developing communication, AI literacy, global perspective, and career planning capabilities.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines practical finance and digital marketing skills with AI and communication training, unlike traditional MBAs’ theory-focused and less tech-integrated approach.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Introduces advanced digital marketing, performance tools, web analytics, and analytics fundamentals like Python, machine learning, and visualization, integrating creativity with technical problem-solving.

courses.title: Managing Self and People Skills
courses.text: Develops interpersonal effectiveness, self-awareness, and leadership abilities. Uses role-play, simulations, and psychometric assessments to strengthen teamwork, communication, and conflict resolution skills.

courses.title: Human-Centered Design Thinking
courses.text: Introduces empathy-driven problem-solving. Students ideate, prototype, and test user-centric solutions for real-world business challenges, emphasizing creativity and practical implementation.

courses.title: CSR, SDGs and Business Research
courses.text: Explores sustainable business practices aligned with global SDGs. Students conduct structured research evaluating corporate social responsibility, ethical decision-making, and societal impact.

courses.title: Career & Leadership Development II: Personal Branding & Professional Networking
courses.text: Focuses on LinkedIn presence, storytelling, and networking strategies. Provides coaching, alumni mentorship, and portfolio creation for enhanced professional visibility.

items.title: Statistics for Business
items.text: Covers descriptive, inferential, and predictive statistics. Students analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, and insights for informed decision-making.

items.title: Decision Making through Predictive Modeling
items.text: Teaches predictive modeling techniques, regression, and forecasting. Students develop models to anticipate outcomes and optimize business strategies

items.title: Ethics in Artificial Intelligence
items.text: Explores ethical implications of AI in business. Students examine bias, privacy, and responsible AI deployment in real-world analytics applications.

items.title: Introduction to Power BI
items.text: Provides hands-on experience with Power BI dashboards and data visualization. Students create reports, track KPIs, and interpret actionable business insights.

items.title: Media and Advertising Strategy
items.text: Explores campaign planning, media mix optimization, brand communication, and ROI measurement. Students create multi-channel advertising strategies for target audiences.

items.title: Social Media and Community Management
items.text: Covers social media marketing, content strategy, audience engagement, and community building. Students manage live campaigns, measure performance, and optimize engagement metrics.

compare.title: Why our semester 2 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Combines hands-on digital marketing, analytics, and leadership, emphasizing real-world campaigns, data-driven insights, and practical skills over theory-heavy approaches.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Focuses on applied business analytics, cybersecurity, economics, leadership resilience, with dual exposure to digital campaigns, commerce, Power BI, and SQL applications.

courses.title: Organisational Behaviour and Human Resource Manager
courses.text: Master the art of making big-picture decisions. Learn how to evaluate competition, allocate resources, and plan for long-term business success in volatile environments.

courses.title: Cyber Security Management
courses.text: Introduces cybersecurity frameworks, threat intelligence, incident response, and regulatory compliance. Students engage with real-world scenarios to protect organizational digital assets.

courses.title: Economics for Decision Making
courses.text: Applies micro and macroeconomic principles to managerial contexts. Covers demand-supply analysis, pricing, market structures, and policy implications for informed business decisions.

courses.title: Career & Leadership Development III: Emotional Intelligence & Resilience
courses.text: Develops self-awareness, adaptability, and resilience in leadership. Students participate in coaching, simulations, and reflective exercises to manage stress and lead effectively.

items.title: Machine Learning for Managers
